breaking_changes.BC_description: The methods .parse and .unparse have been removed in version 3.0.0. Any usage of these methods will result in errors due to their absence.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: The documentation does not specify which classes, objects, or modules the .parse and .unparse methods belonged to, nor does it provide guidance on direct replacements or alternative APIs to achieve the same functionality. Please provide the exact class(es), object(s), or module(s) affected and recommended alternatives with migration examples.
